notes: Content-quality admission and legal eligibility are separate gates.
Gating a Hugging Face repository does not create redistribution rights.
Category booleans are upper bounds, not source approvals; the receipt-bound source_license_adjudication.json is always required.
noncommercial_review permits only source-by-source, noncommercial local training after adjudication and never public redistribution by default.
policy_review and per_item_review remain excluded until explicit source or row-level evidence is implemented.
